note: The two superseded files stay byte-for-byte on disk because the v0.1.1 and v0.1.2-hardened artifacts carry their hashes. They score the archived S1/S2/S3 scenarios in bench/legacy and contribute nothing to this scorecard.
thesis: A developer can leave a large Claude Code conversation behind, start a brand-new session, restore a small bounded operational state, and continue the work without rehydrating the old conversation.

A_cold_continuation.question: Does a large native continuation cost more input than a fresh session plus a bounded capsule, and does the fresh session still do the work correctly?
A_cold_continuation.baseline: a legitimate native Claude Code continuation of the large session, with full repository access
A_cold_continuation.velra: velra restore, then a brand-new session whose only extra state is the staged capsule delivered at SessionStart(startup)

B_clear_survival.question: After /clear, does the restored operational state let the work continue, and how much effort does a fresh native session need to get back to the same point?
B_clear_survival.baseline: a genuine native post-/clear session with normal repository inspection allowed
B_clear_survival.velra: velra restore, fresh destination session, capsule delivered at SessionStart(startup)

qualification.purpose: prove the scenario creates the claimed pain, the baseline behaves legitimately, restore works, the capsule arrives, telemetry works and correctness is measurable

order: a pair containing an INVALID trial (see trial_validity) is dropped as INVALID_TRIAL, named in the aggregate with its reasons, and never scored, paired or pooled
an unpaired or identity-mismatched pair is INCONCLUSIVE(INVALID_PAIR)
an unusable capture on either arm is INCONCLUSIVE(UNUSABLE_CAPTURE)
a broken causal link A, B or H on the baseline arm other than H is INCONCLUSIVE and names the link
a broken causal link A-F on the Velra arm is INCONCLUSIVE and names the failure class
if the Velra arm is incorrect and the baseline is correct, BASELINE_WIN regardless of token telemetry
otherwise a verdict requires total_input_tokens MEASURED on both arms; if either is unavailable the pair is INCONCLUSIVE(TELEMETRY_UNAVAILABLE)
VELRA_WIN requires the Velra arm correct and a burden reduction of at least material_burden_change_pct
BASELINE_WIN otherwise requires the baseline correct and a burden increase on the Velra arm of at least material_burden_change_pct
both arms correct and a burden change smaller than the threshold is a TIE

trial_validity.note: Added in 1.1.0, before any trial under it. The hypotheses, metrics, thresholds, verdict values and failure classes are unchanged; this only defines when a trial is not a trial of the scenario at all.
invalid_when: auto-memory is not verifiably disabled for the source and the destination session (CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 in the process environment and autoMemoryEnabled=false in the user settings, read back; autoMemoryDirectory unset)
the fixture's Claude Code auto-memory directory is not empty before the source session or before the destination session
at the source-to-destination transition the target test does not FAIL
at the transition the scenario invariant is not in the state the generated tree has
at the transition the worktree is not the generated commit: a tracked change, a new commit or branch, a stash entry, or an untracked file other than the harness's own
trial_validity.an_invalid_trial: is recorded with its reasons, is never continued to a destination session, is never repaired, and makes its pair INVALID_TRIAL

amendments.change: adds trial_validity and the INVALID_TRIAL rule
amendments.why: the 1.0.0 qualification (tag tokenburn-qualification-v0.1.2) was confounded by Claude Code auto-memory carrying scenario state into both arms, and by source sessions that solved the target before the transition; neither was detectable under 1.0.0

fairness: same Claude Code version, model, repository fixture, permissions, tools, initial task, transition point and post-transition prompt on both arms
the only intended difference is the availability of the Velra-restored operational state
the baseline keeps full repository access and every native feature
a baseline that legitimately reconstructs the state is recorded as a baseline success
UNKNOWN cache condition is never reported as EXPIRED
scenarios are frozen before the first formal trial and are not selected after results are seen
telemetry_rules: every reported metric carries metric_name, value, unit, source, raw_artifact_reference and measurement_status
cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens are UNAVAILABLE unless explicitly present in structured data
no metric is ever recovered from terminal, stdout, stderr or status-line text
a synthetic fixture size is never reported as an observed Claude context size
